subject: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@rivermark.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

Hi Sofia / Ethan —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our onboarding checklist I want to share the proposed benchmarking roadmap and the load scripts we'll run for acceptance testing. Goal: agree targets and schedule so CS + Performance run the tests next week and produce a single evidence package for procurement.

High-level plan (week of May 17):
- Mon: Smoke and baseline (single-client, warmed KV cache)
- Tue: Throughput ramp (50% -> 100% expected QPS) with 95/99 tail latency collection
- Wed: Sustained run (4-hour window) for concurrency and memory telemetry
- Thu: Failover/fallback (region switch + model variant) verification

Requested confirmations from you:
1) Confirm the target QPS and SLOs you want us to validate (we proposed 1200 qps with 95th < 120ms in the load plan attached).
2) Any constrained data residency or VPC endpoints we must target?
3) Preferred window for the 4-hour sustained run (PST mornings are easiest for us).

Attachments: rivermark-loadscript-v2.yml (load script, ramp profile), telemetry-extraction-guide.pdf (how we collect traces), throughput-targets-sheet.csv (spreadsheet with proposed SLOs).

Next steps: if we get confirmation today we'll lock the schedule and share the runlink + temporary test credentials.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Attachment(s): rivermark-loadscript-v2.yml (yaml), telemetry-extraction-guide.pdf (pdf)
From: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@rivermark.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the detailed plan and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates:
- Target QPS: we are expecting to validate 1,000–1,200 qps for our core inference path (the 1200 proposed is fine, confirm we can run at 1,000 first).
- SLO expectations: 95th < 150ms; 99th < 350ms. We'll accept Redwood's measurement if the telemetry extraction guide shows the same instrumentation points.
- VPC: we'll provide a temporary egress subnet and a short-lived certificate; engineering will share the details by EOD Tue.

Can you also confirm the traffic mix used by the script? We have three routes: /generate-text (60%), /chat-stream (30%), /embed (10%).

Sofia Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | Rivermark Financial
sofia.chen@rivermark.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

FYI — logging in to align test harness params and traffic mix. Quick notes:
- The attached load script uses route weights but we need to tweak payload sizes for /embed to reflect your real distribution (embeds are heavier on token length).
- We'll run two ramp profiles: conservative (1,000 qps) and stretch (1,200 qps). Both will collect per-token latency, model decode time, KV hit rates, and GPU utilization.
- Telemetry extraction: we will drop traces into the shared Drive per the guide; ensure we have read access to the VPC egress IP from your side.

Action items I can take:
- Update load script with your 60/30/10 routing and send for sign-off (today).
- Provision runlink and test creds (Jasmine will share).

Ben
Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@rivermark.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

Thanks Ben — attaching an updated script with the 60/30/10 weights and a tuned embed payload. Sofia / Ethan: please review the small changes (marked in comments). Proposed sustained run window: Thursday May 20, 09:00–13:00 PST. If that works for you we will schedule the runlink and share credentials by Wednesday evening.

Also adding CloudOps Partner (integration@cloudops.inc) on the distribution list to help with the VPC certificate exchange — they will not be in the execution path but will assist procurement/networking.

Attachment: rivermark-loadscript-v2.yml (updated)

Jasmine
From: Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@rivermark.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

All set on our end for the 20th 09:00 PST window. We'll provide the VPC egress subnet and the temporary cert by EOD Friday. One note: procurement asked that the evidence package include a CSV with the per-minute P95/P99 and GPU-util columns — can Redwood include that in the final artifacts?

Ethan
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@rivermark.com>, Ethan Wu <ethan.wu@rivermark.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rivermark onboarding: benchmark roadmap, load scripts & telemetry

Thanks — final confirmation and what we'll deliver after the run:
- Per-minute CSV with P95/P99/P50 and GPU utilization (we will push to the shared Drive).
- Full telemetry bundle (traces, KV hit-rate dumps, model decode histograms).
- A short readout doc with conclusions and suggested quantization / batching knobs if further cost tuning is requested.

I've attached the telemetry-extraction-guide.pdf again and the throughput-targets-sheet.csv for procurement. Ben will run the tests and I'll compile the evidence package within 24 hours of the sustained run finishing.

Action owner summary:
- Ben: execute run + upload per-minute CSV + telemetry (run owner)
- Jasmine: compile package + readout doc + send to procurement
- Monica: stand by for escalation if any SLOs fail during the run

If we don't hear changes by EOD Monday we'll assume the 20th window is firm.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): throughput-targets-sheet.csv, telemetry-extraction-guide.pdf
